text: The Deputy City Manager, Giuilana Carbone, has announced her retirement from the City of Toronto effective June 30, 2021. This report seeks Council authority to appoint an interim Deputy City Manager to ensure continuity in the position prior to the effective start date of the next Deputy City Manager. This Motion is urgent as the current Deputy City Manager, Social and Community Services is retiring at the end of June, and City Council must make an appointment at this meeting.

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Thomas Azouz to the position of Interim Deputy City Manager for the City of Toronto, with such appointment to be effective on July 1, 2021 and ending when City Council appoints a new Deputy City Manager and commences their term, subject to and following written acceptance by Thomas Azouz of the employment agreement offered by the City. 2. City Council authorize the City Manager to negotiate terms and conditions of employment with Thomas Azouz. 3. City Council authorize the public release of the name and curriculum vitae summary of the Interim Deputy City Manager in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 8, 2021) from the City Manager. The following Curriculum Vitae Summary for Thomas Azouz is now public: EMPLOYMENT HISTORY February 2020 – now General Manager, Employment and Social Services (TESS),…
